title: GitHub-backed room binding and fresh-host continuation
question: How does a room bind to its GitHub coordination repository and artifact identities, and how does a fresh host recover an assignment without the originating chat?
answer: A room binds to its GitHub coordination repository and artifact identities (legacy Spec-qualified Tasks, aliases, immutable source) through supported access, with credentials kept untracked; managed adapter and skills are delivered by setup and upgrade and proved in a freshly installed room. A fresh host recovers packet, objective, scope, branch, exact SHA, proof, gap and next action from the Issue and repository owners alone, without the originating chat. Identity reuses S-01W.

confirmation.basis: Binding, setup and upgrade, and fresh-host continuation requirements are owner-accepted direction relayed as settled on 2026-10-01; the grouping into capabilities is provisional and the binding mechanism is not confirmed.

expectedResult.change: Record the cutover precondition for proved capability and fresh-host recovery in the proposed superseding ADR; later plan binding, setup and continuation capabilities in separately assigned Specs.

uncertainty: The supported binding and access route for rooms is unplanned; no GitHub adapter exists at 065a7ce.
Installed-room and cross-host proof (Claude cloud, Codex cloud, local) has not been run.

assessment.basis: Four named claims: C1-C3 are owner-accepted requirements and C4 open alignment, all stated in proposed ADR-000Q at 471a0f0. Fractions unchanged; evidence corrected.
